$description: Pacific2 design tokens v0.6.0 (IN REVIEW, built on CONTEXT v0.6.0). Format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group ($value/$type). Primitive colours are not used directly in components; use semantic tokens.

on-primary.$description: Text/icon on brand.primary (auto black/white when themed)

fg.$description: Needs a person: Paid — unclaimed, Late PayNow

solid.$description: Offline banner fill (inverted, never colour alone)

fg.$description: QR modules: always black, both modes

bg.$description: QR plate + quiet zone: always white, both modes

sans.$description: Default UI stack: Latin system font first, then system 简体中文 fonts. No web fonts are loaded.

sans-zh.$description: Use when lang=zh-Hans so CJK punctuation and full-width forms come from the CJK font.

mono.$value: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "Roboto Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
mono.$description: Codes: approval codes, provider references, pairing codes.

numeric.$value: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Noto Sans SC", "Source Han Sans SC", sans-serif
numeric.$description: Order numbers and money; always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

backoffice.$description: Back Office / Platform console, desktop 1366–1920 px, viewing ~60 cm, mouse + keyboard (WCAG 2.2 AA).

pos.$description: POS 1280×800 touch, viewing ~50 cm, cashier standing.

kiosk.$description: SOK portrait 1080×1920 touch, viewing ~50–70 cm standing. Accessibility mode multiplies by scale.kiosk-a11y (≥ 150%, D-098).

cop.$description: COP phone 390×844 CSS px, one hand, WCAG 2.2 AA; respects the browser text-size setting (rem-based).

kds.$description: KDS 1920×1080 landscape, dark by default, read at 1–2 m in a hot, bright kitchen; bump bar + touch.

qms.$description: QMS 1920x1080 landscape TV. All text readable at 3 m (min 44 px). Sizes fitted to 4 stall sections of ~440 px; order-number-xl when <= 2 sections. See DESIGN_SYSTEM 4.3.

backoffice.$description: Min interactive height on desktop (WCAG 2.5.8 needs 24)

pos.$description: Min target on POS; item tiles use pos-tile

kiosk-primary.$description: Kiosk primary CTA height (Pay, Add to cart)

keypad-key.$description: POS numeric keypad / PIN key (kiosk uses kiosk-primary)

late-blink.$description: KDS late timer blink period (1 Hz; WCAG 2.3.1 allows <= 3/s)

qms-page.$description: QMS page cycle when a section has more than 6 Ready or 6 Preparing numbers (SA-70, G3 Q-UI3)

kds-ticket.$description: KDS ticket column width at 1920 (5 columns)

qms-section.$description: QMS stall section width at 4 sections

logo-slot-cop.$description: Store logo slot, COP / cart group kiosk

logo-slot-sm.$description: Store logo slot, POS / COP cart group

frame-kiosk-panel.$description: Kiosk content panel width inside 1080 minus padding

frame-pos-w.$description: POS device frame width (prototype + layout reference)

stroke.$description: Stroke on the 24 px grid; scale with the icon

comfortable.$description: Default. Multiplier on space tokens inside lists and grids

compact.$description: Back Office tables, POS order list (never below the surface min target)

kiosk-a11y-scale.$description: Text multiplier in kiosk accessibility mode (>= 150%, D-098)

kiosk-a11y-reach.$description: All controls inside the lower 60% of the screen (US-310)

kiosk-top.$description: No operator content above this line on kiosk (privacy, header)

qms.$description: QMS capacity per stall section per page (G3 Q-UI3: panel >= 43 in, 6 Ready + 6 Preparing per page with paging). Applies at any section count; order-number-xl is used when <= 2 sections.

ready-per-page.$description: Ready tiles per section per page (2 columns x 3 rows)

preparing-per-page.$description: Preparing numbers per section per page (3 columns x 2 rows)
